range-atlas.alt: Topographic chart of the named mountain ranges, plateaux and basins of the region, with surveyed summit elevations marked.

meridian-chart.alt: Analytical chart of watercourses and landform boundaries plotted against a two degree graticule.

approach-chart.alt: Close survey of a river system threading between landform boundaries, drawn at one degree spacing.

world-departure.alt: World coastline with every built up area in the source dataset marked, drawn cool and quiet.

world-systems.alt: The same world coastline and built up areas, drawn under a red cast.

orbital.alt: The planet drawn on an orthographic projection centred on the region, coastlines and built up areas picked out.
